items.claim: Story feeds the field placeholder black after "None" without `unset`
items.note: This is a story-only change with nothing a consumer sees, so it has no changeset. The new `SwatchStrip.stories.test.tsx` checks it.

items.claim: The provider wrap depends on whether `store` equals the context's store, so swatches remount
items.note: The strip now wraps whenever it has any store, so the grids also stay mounted when the prop stops matching the provider.

items.claim: Current swatch match compares non-hex colors by their exact spelling
items.note: Both colors now go through paint's `tryParseColor` to `#rrggbbaa`, and fall back to `normalizeRecentColor` for anything paint can't read.
